title: DOC-OC (V1 → V2)
subtitle: Universal Academic Document Intelligence & Edge VLM Engine
problem: Extracting structured data from diverse, unstandardized Indian board marksheets (CBSE, ICSE, UP, Haryana, etc.) with security watermarks, bilingual headers, and varied layouts is slow (~10 mins/doc) and error-prone. The initial V1 cascade (YOLO + TableTransformer + regex) was brittle across board formatting changes, and cloud OCR APIs incurred high costs ($0.02–$0.05/page) while compromising student privacy.
approach:
Engineered the full progression from a heuristic CV cascade to an offline edge Vision-Language Model (VLM):
• V1 (CV Cascade): Built a multi-board extraction pipeline with OpenCV, custom YOLOv8 layout detection, Hugging Face Table Transformers, and structure-retaining OCR (LLM Whisperer) with strict fraud-mitigation checks, backed by FastAPI and MySQL.
• V2 (Multimodal Edge VLM): Completely re-architected into a 100% offline, zero-cloud VLM engine running Gemma-4-E2B locally via llama.cpp (100% GPU offload on RTX 4050 6GB). Implemented C++ GBNF grammar-constrained decoding to deterministically mask illegal token logits and guarantee RFC 8259 JSON compliance. Slashed latency by 4.3× (from ~28–30s to ~6.28s) by disabling internal reasoning traces and applying Lanczos 1600px scaling. Performed ShortGPT layer redundancy profiling (Blocks 14-15) and engineered Pydantic self-healing domain arithmetic validation (Theory + Practical total reconciliation, leading-zero type coercion).
outcomes: V1 → V2 Progression: Evolved from a brittle CV/OCR heuristic cascade into a unified, 100% offline multimodal edge VLM engine
4.3× Latency Reduction: Dropped processing time from ~28–30s down to ~6.28s per document on a consumer GPU (RTX 4050 6GB, 83 tokens/sec)
Deterministic Schema Compliance: C++ GBNF grammar decoding masks illegal token transitions, eliminating JSON syntax errors and schema drift
Self-Healing Validation: Automated arithmetic reconciliation (Theory + Practical) and RFC 8259 leading-zero coercion via Pydantic validators
Zero Cloud Cost & Complete Privacy: 100% local GPU execution in ~2.8–3.2 GB resident VRAM with zero external API dependencies

title: Advanzia AutoLend
subtitle: Autonomous Credit Limit Optimization
problem: Traditional credit limit adjustments rely on static rules that fail to adapt to real-time risk signals, leaving portfolio profit on the table while exposing lenders to uncontrolled default rates.
approach: Implemented a Dueling Double DQN-based risk optimization engine inspired by existing research on dynamic credit limit optimization, combined with a Cox Proportional Hazard Model to estimate default probabilities. Architected a high-throughput microservices backend (Spring Boot, FastAPI) leveraging Kafka event streams and Redis caching.
outcomes: Dynamic credit limit adjustment optimized using PyTorch reinforcement learning
Microservices backend benchmarking throughput at 5,000+ requests/min under 300ms latency
Immutable double-entry ledger architecture with complete audit trails
Simulation pipeline modeling 10,000+ synthetic users for policy pre-training

title: Anand Kosh (आनंद कोष)
subtitle: Clinical Record Digitization & Hospital Management Platform
problem: Healthcare providers handle hundreds of physical patient files daily, resulting in search bottlenecks, paper degradation, and confidentiality vulnerabilities during clinical operations.
approach: Engineered a full-stack clinical management and patient record digitization portal in active hospital production. Architected a 3-tier Role-Based Access Control system (Administrators, Medical Staff, Clinical Observers) with serverless PostgreSQL (Neon), Prisma ORM, and automated medical document archival via Google Drive API.
outcomes: Live in Daily Hospital Production: Actively used by hospital medical staff and clinical observers
Hundreds of Patient Records Managed: Real-time secure document archival and fast clinical retrieval
3-Tier RBAC Architecture: Enforced clinical confidentiality with JWT-based auth and bcrypt hashing
Serverless PostgreSQL Backend: Neon serverless database with automated archival and zero-downtime availability

title: Campus Intel
subtitle: Unified Campus Intelligence & Automation Platform
problem: Educational institutions suffer from fragmented platforms across student portals, administrative document corrections, and library book tracking, lacking real-time AI assistance and requiring expensive dedicated barcode hardware.
approach: Built a comprehensive multi-service platform combining FAISS-powered RAG AI chat for campus queries, automated marksheet document verification, and a smart library management system (absorbing Pustak Tracker) that turns mobile phone cameras into real-time barcode scanners with JWT authentication and automated fine calculation — deployed as containerized microservices.
outcomes: Unified campus ecosystem merging student portal, administrative correction workflows, and mobile library tracking
AI-powered campus assistant utilizing FAISS vector retrieval and RAG for institutional queries
Replaced dedicated barcode scanner hardware with mobile camera vision, cutting infrastructure costs
Multi-service architecture (4 backend services) with live production deployment on Render
Top 3 in HackTheWinter offline final round
